en-US.title: Vibe
en-US.subtitle: Snap a selfie, get a score
en-US.description:
Vibe reads the room in your selfie and gives it a score out of 100, with a short written take and the five factors behind it: lighting, smile, energy, framing, and charisma.

Scoring happens entirely on your device. Your photo is never uploaded.

Share a result to the public feed if you want to see how your read compares, or keep it to yourself. Four looks are built in — Field, Real, Neo, and Meme — so the app can match your mood.

No account. No email. No password.
en-US.releaseNotes: Four switchable looks, a redrawn icon, and reporting and blocking in the feed.
en-US.promoText: Snap a selfie. Get a score. Leave with a story.
